_readme: Single source for every Amazon product on the site. _tools/build.py renders
the cards on the home shop grid, the essentials page and the gift section
from this file, in EN/DE/SQ. Edit here, then run: python3 _tools/build.py
Store: amazon.de, Associates tag besagoods21-21 (settings). Links are
'asin' must be the amazon.de ASIN supplied by the owner. Never guess one,
and never reuse the old amazon.com/.es ASINs (kept only as history in
'hidden': true removes a product from every page (shop, essentials, gifts).
A visible product without an asin falls back to its old 'legacy_link'
(amazon.com, old tag) and the build prints a NOT READY warning.
No prices or budgets for Amazon items: the button just says 'Buy on Amazon'.
